name: council-dial
description: Council Dial from Ablation Lab: runs a review council of subagents in the configuration you choose and logs each run's type and results for comparison.

plugins.name: council-dial
plugins.description: Runs a review council of Claude subagents the way you choose, read-only by default, and logs each run. A local script writes the briefs and records the results (findings, kept and dismissed, fixes that later failed), so council types can be compared. A council can flag an rm -rf that could delete the wrong data, as well as bugs, security issues and wrong docs, but may miss some. Needs Node.js; the script writes only the review log and the agents' saved reports, and makes no network requests.
